summary:
Implemented TF-0297 / A05 (re-verify the A5 Adaptive Context Budget controlled pilot gate) in the workspace, without reinstalling dependencies or touching the network.

What the tree looked like: the trial workspace equals the repository baseline except that eight A5/P5 evidence test files had been deleted (tests/unit/deprecation-counters.test.ts, tests/unit/performance-budgets.test.ts, tests/unit/resource-aware-wave-scheduler.test.ts, openclaw_runtime/src/observability/deprecation-counters.test.ts, .../compaction/compression-planner.test.ts, .../agent-hooks/compaction-budget-shadow.test.ts, .../agent-hooks/compaction-promotion.test.ts, .../context-engine/context-orchestrator.test.ts), and openclaw_runtime/src/agents/cross-area/cross-area-facades.ts plus tests/unit/cross-area-composition.test.ts did not exist at all — while a5-adaptive-context-budget-pilot.md already referenced the latter two.

Changes made:
1. Restored the composition facade openclaw_runtime/src/agents/cross-area/cross-area-facades.ts per docs/runtime-design/area-composition-spec.md (Pair 3 A5+A2, Pair 5 A5+A6) and development-manual criterion 3.6: `ContextBudgetPlanner` (plan / pause / `replanOnResume`), `estimateTaskComplexity`, `resolveA5BudgetDegradation`, and `CrossAreaCompositionFacade`. It is read-only toward the production ladder (only calls `resolveTierThresholds`, earlier-only clamp; never hardcodes 0.6/0.75/0.85/0.95), degrades estimation failures to a conservative `unknown` plan instead of blocking a turn, and honors `degrade_to_default_budget` from the existing deprecation registry by falling back to the production ladder in shadow mode. Wave propagation always goes through `ResourceAwareWaveScheduler.rePlan`, so started/completed waves stay immutable.
2. Restored the eight deleted P5/A5 test files byte-identically (verified by SHA256 against the repository baseline tree) so every `requiredTests` entry resolves to a real file.
3. Added tests/unit/cross-area-composition.test.ts (criteria 3.6 / 3.9, Pair 3 + Pair 5), tests/unit/deep/a5-deep.test.ts (criteria 1, 2, 3.6, 3.9, 4.14, 4.10 + P5 clamp / diagnostics-only / default-ladder invariants) and tests/unit/a05-a5-gate-coverage.test.ts (static guard: requiredTests reachability, original threshold text, `degrade_to_default_budget`, real A5 counter call sites in compaction-safeguard.ts and compact.ts, budgetShadow absent from CompressionArtifact, facade read-only-ness).
4. Added harness/specs/tasks/harness-gap-a05-adaptive-context-budget-pilot-reverify.md (validates clean), docs/dev/harness-gap-closure/a05-adaptive-context-budget-gate.md, a05-acceptance.json and A05-SHA256SUMS (8 entries, read-back verified).
5. Only body text was appended to a5-adaptive-context-budget-pilot.md ("Re-verification note (A05)"); its frontmatter `acceptance` / `requiredTests` / `requiredProfiles` are unchanged and still match the frozen A05 pilot contract in source-inventory.json (verified programmatically). No thresholds were redefined or relaxed; no product locks changed.

Important honesty note recorded in the evidence: this workspace has no node_modules and dependency installation/network use is prohibited, so `vitest`, `pnpm run typecheck`, `eslint`, `comms:replay/compare`, and `harness run --dry-run` (needs a git diff base; there is no .git) were NOT executed and are recorded as `not-run`, not as passing. Instead the same logic was exercised by running the in-repo TypeScript modules directly under Node's type stripping in a transient scratch tree (deleted afterwards), and the coverage-guard assertions were recomputed against the tree; all passed. scripts/check-harness-gap-baseline.mjs keeps only its pre-existing baseline failures and gained no A05 drift entry. Credential scan over 15 touched files: 0 hits.
